question: According to the Census of India 2011, what was the literacy rate recorded in Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.94**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **0.94** was the literacy rate recorded in Kerala according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• Kerala has the highest literacy rate among all the states in India.
 
• This high literacy rate is attributed to the state's robust educational policies and extensive network of schools and colleges.
 
• The state government has consistently prioritized education, leading to significant improvements in literacy over the years.
 
• Kerala's literacy rate is significantly higher than the national average, reflecting the state's commitment to education and human development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Census of India** is conducted every ten years to collect demographic data across the country.
 
• The first Census of India was conducted in **1871**.
 
• The Census provides critical data that helps in planning and policy-making at both the state and national levels.
 
• Literacy rate is defined as the percentage of people aged 7 and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• In the 2011 Census, the overall literacy rate in India was recorded at **74.04%**.
 
• Kerala has consistently maintained a high literacy rate due to its focus on universal education and adult literacy programs.
